item.title: About
item.description:
👋Hi there! I’m charming-c, a master’s student at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU) with a strong interest in operating systems and network programming. I graduated from Central China Normal University (CCNU), where I developed a passion for the inner workings of computer systems.

My focus lies in understanding and building efficient systems—whether it’s exploring OS internals like memory management and process scheduling or diving into network programming such as io_uring and socket. Outside of academics, I enjoy hands-on projects, contributing to open-source initiatives, and sharing my learnings through this blog.
